records.title: Tidepool atlas
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original landscape artwork for an adult jigsaw puzzle concept, about 1536x1024 pixels.
Primary request: Tidepool atlas, a top-down imaginative coastal mosaic of interlocking natural tide pools.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed shoreline viewed straight down. Many differently shaped shallow pools with jewel turquoise and indigo water, coral-like branching forms, russet kelp, green algae, violet anemones, orange starfish, shell fragments, smooth patterned pebbles, rippled wet sand and narrow stone paths between pools.
Style/medium: richly detailed original painted natural-history-inspired illustration, tactile gouache textures and crisp organic edges, not a scientific diagram. Delightful tiny discoveries.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2; the entire rectangle filled with varied recognizable regions, no large empty sea or repeated pattern. Small and large pools mixed, rock textures and vegetation create strong local landmarks; saturated water offset by warm stones.
Lighting/mood: clear sunlit shallows, calm and curious.
Constraints: one single complete artwork, not a grid or contact sheet. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logo, brand, signature, watermark, frame, box mockup, visible jigsaw cuts or pieces. Original imaginary environment; do not imitate a named artist.
records.pixelInspection: Passed actual-pixel inspection via view_image. Jewel water, shells, algae, pebbles and tide-pool boundaries create many recognizable local landmarks. No visible text, logo, watermark or cut overlay.

records.revisionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the provided Saturday market illustration.
Primary request: Remove every tiny accidental written mark, number, letter, price tag and sign from this artwork. In particular remove the small white price card above the foreground orange basket on the left, the little white price card near the center-right market stalls, and the dark scribbled marks on the foreground wooden flower crate at the lower left. Replace each card with the surrounding produce or natural material; make the marked crate plain textured wood. Remove any other pseudo-lettering on jars, crates or cards.
Constraints: change only these small accidental text-like marks. Keep exactly the same composition, landscape aspect ratio, color palette, people, produce, bicycle, canopies, harbor, flowers, textiles and painting texture. No crop. Keep no readable or unreadable text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, signs, signatures, watermark, borders or puzzle-cut overlays anywhere. One full-bleed original artwork.
records.pixelInspection: Original generation contained tiny pseudo-price labels and crate scribbles. A targeted builtin edit removed them; the final PNG passed actual-pixel inspection via view_image. Produce, canopies, textiles, flowers and bicycle remain distinct. No visible text, logo, watermark or cut overlay.
